title: stats
description: Numbers side by side, each large under its label, with a note under it such as the change since last time, coloured by its tone

value.description: The number, in quotes as it is drawn: '14.9'

unit.description: Drawn small after the value, such as MB or %

note.description: A short line under the value, such as +5 since last week

tone.description: The note's colour: good for a change for the better, bad for the worse
